title: NASA Task Load Index (NASA-TLX)
status: published instrument (Hart & Staveland 1988); NASA public-domain material [PK]

license.holder: NASA Ames Research Center (US Government work)
license.citation: Hart SG, Staveland LE. Development of NASA-TLX: results of empirical and theoretical research. Adv Psychol. 1988;52:139-183.
license.notes: Distributed publicly by NASA; US Government work [PK - verify before publication]. Ratings recorded 0-100 in steps of 5 (21 gradations). Performance anchors run Perfect (0) to Failure (100).

items.text: Mental Demand: How mentally demanding was the task?
items.label: Mental Demand

items.text: Physical Demand: How physically demanding was the task?
items.label: Physical Demand

items.text: Temporal Demand: How hurried or rushed was the pace of the task?
items.label: Temporal Demand

items.text: Performance: How successful were you in accomplishing what you were asked to do?
items.label: Performance

items.text: Effort: How hard did you have to work to accomplish your level of performance?
items.label: Effort

items.text: Frustration: How insecure, discouraged, irritated, stressed, and annoyed were you?
items.label: Frustration
